name: touch
summary: Creates an empty file or updates its timestamps.
description: Its main job is to set a file’s access and modification times to now. If the file does not exist, touch creates it empty: that is the most common use. The contents of an existing file are never changed.

options.description: Does not create the file if it does not exist.
Changes only the last access time.
Changes only the last modification time.
Uses the given date instead of now: "2024-01-15 08:30", "yesterday"…
Copies the timestamps of another file.

examples.explanation: Creates an empty notes.txt if it does not exist, otherwise updates its timestamp.
Creates several files in one go.
The shell’s brace expansion creates file1.txt to file5.txt.
